findings.title: Temporal/comparative naming: formatBytesEnhanced names the edit, not the behavior
findings.description: "Enhanced" relative to what? The name records that this function came after formatBytes, not what it does. Fold the negative-value handling into formatBytes or name the function for its behavior.

findings.title: Changelog-style comment records edit history in code
findings.description: "// Fixed bug where negative values were not handled" is commit-message content; in the file it goes stale the moment the code changes again. Git history already records it.

findings.title: Placeholder text: unimplemented behavior presented as implemented
findings.description: "In a real implementation, this would use the user's locale settings" — the code admits it is a stand-in; locale handling does not happen.
